Installation, Commissioning and Operational Training The bidder shall ensure proper installation, commissioning and successful demo nstration of the instrument at the purchaser's institution. The installation shall b e carried out by qualified and experienced technical personnel. The bidder shall provide comprehensive hands-on training to the designated faculty members a nd technical staff regarding instrument operation, software handling, calibration, routine maintenance, safety precautions and basic troubleshooting. All installation, commissioning and initial training activities shall be completed o n-site without any additional cost to the purchaser. 2. After-Sales Service and Technical Support The bidder shall ensure prompt, reliable and accessible after-sales service and t echnical support at the installation site throughout the warranty period. The bid der shall have adequate technical support arrangements within Kerala to attend to service requests without undue delay. A qualified service engineer shall be m ade available for on-site inspection and troubleshooting whenever required. The bidder shall provide contact details of the designated service personnel and ens ure continuous technical assistance for the smooth functioning of the instrumen t. 3. Timely Maintenance and Breakdown Support The bidder shall provide timely preventive maintenance, breakdown support an d necessary technical assistance throughout the warranty period. The bidder sh all respond to service complaints within 24–48 hours and arrange an on-site visi t, wherever necessary, within 3 working days of receiving the complaint. Any de

fective parts or components requiring replacement during the warranty period s hall be repaired or replaced without additional cost, as per the warranty terms. The bidder shall ensure that service interruptions are minimised and that the in strument remains in proper working condition. 4. The bidder should have a registered office in Kerala. Upload the Kerala GST c ertificate. 5. Share the following details Details of the bidder's service centre or technical support facility in Kerala. Cont act details of the service engineer responsible for the institution. 6. The bidder shall be responsible to do the necessary electrical works for the pr oper installation of the equipment at the buyer’s institution. PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS Orbital Shaking Incubator Qty 1 · Specially designed to have a combined advant age of closely controlled incubation/storage temperature with orbital shaking ne cessary for many laboratory uses like tissue cultures, fermentation studies, enz yme reactions, controlled purification, ageing tests, growth studies etc., Double wall construction, the exterior is made of MS duly powder coated and interior of SS. · The door having glass window makes it possible to inspect specimen witho ut disturbing the temperature. · Powerful air circulator creates positive airflow t hrough the Incubator. · Temp. Range: 5°C-60°C · Shaking speed : 50-250RPM · Platform Size: 360x360mm · Capacity: 16 flasksx250ml . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
